description: List the user's OWN listings (any status), newest first. Resolved from the authenticated agent key — only ever returns this user's listings. Use status='pending' to see what is awaiting moderation, status='rejected' for declined ones.

limit.description: Maximum results to return per page, 1-50. Default 20. Example: 10.

offset.description: How many results to skip, for paging. Default 0. Example: 20 returns the second page when limit is 20.

status.description: Filter YOUR listings by moderation/lifecycle status. Use "pending" to see what is awaiting AI moderation, "rejected" for declined ones, "all" (default) for everything.

name: list_my_listings
